# Microsoft Copilot Studio — what's new (literal entry list)
# Captured 2026-10-06 from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/whats-new
# ms.date 2026-10-05 | updated_at 2026-10-06T01:04Z
# FEED STATUS: LIVE AGAIN. Was frozen at the July 2026 edition for ~12 weeks.
# NOTE: store the LITERAL entry list here, never a prose summary.

## September 2026
extract node — pull named values and tables out of documents (invoices, contracts, financial statements)
Copilot node (Preview) — run Copilot Chat or a Cowork task, grounded in connected user's mail/files/calendar/chats; call Researcher, Analyst, or Agent Builder agents
Model dropdown for agents powered by the GitHub Copilot harness, incl. experimental models
Content safety test method in agent evaluation — configurable severity thresholds
Attach files (GA) — expanded to Excel, PowerPoint, Word
Dataverse tables as a knowledge source — incl. (preview) unstructured reasoning over Multiline Text and File columns

## August 2026
Usage-based billing / Copilot Credits for GitHub Copilot harness agents, workflows, apps
Fabric IQ connection (Preview)
Microsoft Agent 365 onboarding for centralized governance
Control image rendering and embedded URLs in agent responses
Azure SQL tables as a knowledge source
Work IQ (Preview)

## July 2026
Automatic Microsoft Entra Agent ID for every new agent; no environment-level opt-out
Workflow or MCP server as a tool for GitHub Copilot harness agents (Preview)
MCP server submission for Microsoft certification (Preview)
Real-time agent across voice and digital messaging; GPT-5-Chat (Preview); App Insights monitoring
Environment-level agent telemetry export to Azure Application Insights (Preview)
File attachments and agent-created files for GitHub Copilot harness agents (Preview)

## June 2026
GitHub Copilot harness (production-ready preview)
Work IQ for GitHub Copilot harness agents
Skills for GitHub Copilot harness agents
Memory for GitHub Copilot harness agents
Windows 365 for Agents MCP server (GA)
Condition groups
Voice agents with Teams Phone Agent (Preview)
Connect other agents for delegation (Preview)
Foundry IQ connection (Preview)
Claude Sonnet 5 or GPT-5.5 Chat as primary model (GA)

## May 2026
Computer use (GA)
Prompt node in agent flows
Microsoft 365 Copilot node in workflows
Consent-based recording for voice agents
Agent inventory schema (admin center, API, Azure Resource Graph)
Agent readiness and issue status page (Preview)
Asynchronous responses for agent flows
Microsoft Entra Agent IDs per agent (Preview)
Computer use standalone tools (Preview)
Mistral Medium 3.5 as primary model (Preview)
